question: Why are some milk and juice cartons so hard to recycle?
answer: Some milk and juice cartons are made of three layers: paper, plastic and aluminum. Those materials are glued together as one wall, which made the carton hard to recycle. The page lets you drag the wall apart to see each layer.
move: One carton, three materials glued as one: that's what made it so hard to recycle.
